subject: Renewal + capacity upgrade: invoice entity, VAT ID & PO request
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lena Torres <lena.torres@dynasafe.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 1 Sep 2028 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity upgrade: invoice entity, VAT ID & PO request

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for the meeting yesterday. To summarize: DynaSafe is ready to commit to the 75% capacity uplift (from 400k tokens/month to 700k) on the upcoming renewal, and we'd like to finalize invoicing details so we can generate the amendment and get procurement queued.

What we need from your side to move the contract to billing:
- Confirm the exact invoice payee name (you mentioned DynaSafe GmbH in Germany).
- Provide the VAT ID or EU tax registration (we'll need this on the invoice).
- Confirm the PO number (or let us know when AP will issue it).
- Any requested net terms change (current renewal default is Net30; you mentioned checking Net45).

I've attached the updated renewal quote that includes the capacity uplift and prorated charges for the remainder of the term (Renewal_Quote_Redwood_v3.pdf). If you can reply with the VAT ID and PO or a rough ETA on the PO, we'll create the invoice routing and hand the request to billing.

Next steps I propose: once we have the PO + VAT ID, I will loop in Marissa (billing) to set the invoice entity and confirm net terms, then Aditya will coordinate signature and DocuSign.

Thanks — let me know if you'd prefer a short call with AP on our side to unblock the PO.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Renewal_Quote_Redwood_v3.pdf

From: Lena Torres <lena.torres@dynasafe.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 Sep 2028 10:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity upgrade: invoice entity, VAT ID & PO request

Hi Mina —

Great to hear — we are moving forward with the uplift. A few notes from AP so you have them on file:
- Invoice payee should be: DynaSafe GmbH (legal entity).
- VAT ID: DE299887112 (attached scanned certificate).
- Our finance team will approve a PO; they expect to issue PO #DS-2028-0915 by next week (ETA 9/8-9/10).
- Regarding net terms: they prefer Net45 but will accept Net30 for the first renewal if we can offer Net45 for subsequent invoices (they want this captured in the amendment).

I attached the VAT certificate (DynaSafe_VAT.pdf). Once you confirm the invoice entity is set to DynaSafe GmbH and the quote is updated with the new PO field, I'll follow up with AP to make sure the PO is generated on time.

Thanks,
Lena
Director of Procurement
DynaSafe GmbH
lena.torres@dynasafe.com
+49 30 5550 3377

Attachment: DynaSafe_VAT.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Sep 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal + capacity upgrade: invoice entity, VAT ID & PO request

Marissa — forwarding Lena's confirmation. Key items for billing workflow:
- New invoice payee: DynaSafe GmbH
- VAT ID provided: DE299887112 (attached)
- PO pending: DS-2028-0915 (ETA 2028-09-08 — Lena will confirm once AP issues it)
- Net terms ask: request Net45 going forward; AP ok with Net30 for the current pro-rated invoice if we can switch future invoices to Net45 (capture in amendment).

Can you:
1) Create a billing profile for DynaSafe GmbH and confirm the invoice entity mapping.
2) Prepare a pro-forma invoice for the prorated capacity uplift and hold until we receive PO — the customer needs the invoice to attach to the PO request.
3) Confirm whether we can mark the next invoices Net45 in our system and note the initial invoice Net30 if required.

I've left an internal note attached with the negotiated pricing and effective dates (internal-billing-note.txt). Aditya — please confirm if you want this captured as an amendment or a one-time addendum.

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround on this so we meet their procurement window.

Thanks,
Mina

Attachment: internal-billing-note.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Sep 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal + capacity upgrade: invoice entity, VAT ID & PO request

Thanks for the heads up — I've set up the DynaSafe GmbH billing profile in Zuora (entity mapping complete) and uploaded the VAT certificate to the customer record.

Actions taken:
- Drafted pro-forma invoice (Redwood_Invoice_D-48219.pdf) for the prorated capacity uplift and attached a preliminary invoice number. I'll hold final posting until we receive PO DS-2028-0915.
- We can set subsequent invoices to Net45 in our billing system; I've added a note on the account and flagged the next recurring invoice to use Net45 terms post-amendment. The first pro-rated invoice will be posted Net30 unless AP explicitly confirms Net45 before invoice generation.
- Created a DocuSign envelope for the amendment and included the Net45 language for future invoices. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/embedded?d=abcdef123456

Please ask Lena to send the PO to accounts@redwood.com (CC me) once issued. Once we have PO + final signature, I'll post the invoice and send the signed amendment back to you both.

Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_Invoice_D-48219.pdf
